title: Breast Cancer Awareness Month: know your normal, know the signs

slides.title: Get these changes checked

Know your normal, so you'll notice what's new. 🎀

The last week of Breast Cancer Awareness Month is a good time to learn the signs worth a call to your doctor:
✔️ A new lump in the breast or underarm
✔️ Swelling or thickening, even without a lump
✔️ Skin dimpling, redness or flaky skin
✔️ A nipple that turns inward, or discharge that isn't milk
✔️ A change in size or shape, or new pain in one area

Most breast lumps are not cancer, but every new change deserves a check. And because some breast cancers cause no signs at all, keep up your screening mammograms even when you feel fine.

Know your normal, so you'll notice what's new. During Breast Cancer Awareness Month, here are the breast changes worth a call to your doctor, according to the CDC and the American Cancer Society: a new lump in the breast or underarm; swelling or thickening, even without a lump; skin dimpling, redness or flaky skin; a nipple that turns inward, or discharge that isn't breast milk; a change in size or shape; or new pain in one area. Most breast lumps are not cancer, but every new change deserves a check, and a diagnostic mammogram usually needs your doctor's order. Some breast cancers cause no signs at all, so keep up your screening mammograms even when you feel fine. Good to know: a change isn't a diagnosis. Most breast lumps are not cancer, but get every new one checked. Normal changes happen with periods, pregnancy and menopause. Underarm lumps and swollen glands count, too. Some breast cancers cause no signs at all.

Noticed something? What to do next: 1, call your doctor; don't wait for your next screening. 2, get a diagnostic exam, a 3D mammogram, often with an ultrasound. 3, get answers: results go to your doctor in 48 to 72 hours.

facts_checked: Checked 2026-10-23. CDC 'Symptoms of Breast Cancer' (new lump in breast or underarm; thickening or swelling; irritation or dimpling; redness or flaky skin; pulling in of nipple or nipple pain; discharge other than milk; change in size or shape; pain in any area; some people have no symptoms; symptoms can come from non-cancer conditions; see your doctor right away). ACS 'Breast Cancer Signs and Symptoms' (new lump most common symptom, most lumps not cancer; swelling without a lump; dimpling; nipple turning inward; swollen lymph nodes under arm or near collarbone; menstrual cycle, pregnancy, menopause can change breast tissue; have any new change checked; keep up screening). ACS screening guideline summary (40-44 choice of yearly; 45-54 yearly; 55+ every 2 years or yearly). USPSTF 2024 final (every 2 years, 40-74). Practice facts from amiweb main 1c25a34: services-data.ts mammography (Hologic 3D, female technologist, diagnostic for lump/pain/call-back needs physician's order, results to physician 48-72 h, breast ultrasound often added for a specific area of concern $195, screening covered in full by most plans from 40); prices.ts mammo $295 (one self-pay 3D mammogram, screening or diagnostic, since Oct 20 2026); constants.ts phone and hours.
